conviction_note: abs_move 4.5 (the 7-day straddle is 4.75%, realised vol is 42.9% after the SpaceX shock, the last three reactions were 5.8/1.6/11.8, and AT&T moved about -5 to -6% on its own print two days ago) x p_up 55 = +0.45. The findings sum to -0.40 because the one hard read-through, AT&T's beat-and-raise being sold, points down. The lean above 50 comes from three things that are not findings: VZ's own 7-of-7 positive reaction history, the upside-paid skew (-4.67) and a CEO who promised positive Q3 phone accounts two-thirds of the way through the quarter. That is why the two measurements differ in sign. p_up was 56 before LESSONS and moved to 55 because the CEO's promise sits inside public guidance.
bar: Q3 2026 adj. EPS about $1.27-1.28 and revenue about $34.87bn (sweep row; Hudson Labs preview 2026-10-06, https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/verizon-q3-2026-earnings-preview-vz-guidance-estimates-key). EPS $4.99-5.04, FCF $21.9-22.1bn. I could not source a consensus for Q3 phone net adds (no FactSet or Visible Alpha number found), so findings on that line are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 88.9M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up 5.7% from 84.1M; days to cover 3.72 against a 24-report average of 3.74 (https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/vz/short-interest). That is about 2% of float and not crowded. The Aug-20 snapshot read 2.0% of float, per a secondary aggregator. Skew_25d is -4.67 vol points, so upside is paid. Put/call OI is 0.55. Event-implied move is 0.0% after the variance subtraction, because the 7-day straddle (4.75%) is fully explained by elevated 20d realised vol (42.9%). Tape: spot 44.56, -5.35% over 20 days, -13.4% from the 52w high, a bounce of about 7% off the 2026-10-09 close of 41.65. Insiders: 10 open-market sales and 0 buys over 6 months (quiverquant).

findings.finding: AT&T's Q3 2026 release (8-K, 2026-10-21) beat on adj. EPS ($0.65 vs ~$0.60) and revenue ($32.3bn vs $31.7bn) and raised the 2026 adj. EPS outlook to the '$2.40 range'. Postpaid phone net adds were 379k against ~387k expected and 405k a year earlier, phone churn was 0.92% (flat YoY), and the release says promotional discounts on subscriber additions partly offset pricing. The stock still fell about 5-6% that day and VZ fell 3.2% in sympathy. The peer that printed after VZ last spoke had a beat-and-raise sold, with the market focused on satellite competition, the capex cut and a $2.6bn impairment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: VZ's own last 7 prints all reacted positive (median |move| 2.26%, +5.84% on the Q2 2026 beat-and-raise). The peer print shows the current tape selling a telecom beat-and-raise, which is a different reaction function from VZ's own history.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: VZ already gave up 3.2% on 2026-10-21 and has since recovered to 44.56. If the market fully expected VZ to be sold the same way, the skew would be put-bid. It is call-bid at -4.67, so the options market leans toward a relief reaction that AT&T did not get.
findings.independence: Reaction: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-att-nyse-t-stock-price-down-63-should-you-sell-2026-10-21/ (T -6.3% midday) and https://finviz.com/news/405566/why-is-att-stock-falling-despite-beating-third-quarter-earnings-estimates. VZ sympathy move: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Verizon+Falls+as+Telecom+Sentiment+Weakens+Ahead+of+Its+Earnings. These are reports on the same event and not independent evidence for VZ's own quarter.

findings.finding: At Goldman Sachs Communacopia on 2026-09-09, with about two-thirds of Q3 elapsed, CEO Schulman committed to three things: Q3 would be the first quarter in at least three years with positive phone net accounts; 2026 postpaid phone net adds would land at the TOP end of the 750k-1M guide (about 761k needed in H2 against 184k in Q2); and churn would keep improving YoY with no 'phones on us'. The comparison quarter (Q3 2025) was 44k phone net adds. A CEO giving this specific a promise this late in the quarter implies he could see the numbers. The risk is that the bar is now set at a pace far above Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (184k phone adds, best Consumer Q2 in five years, guide raised) reacted +5.84%. Q1 2026 reacted +1.55%. The Jan 2026 print with the first Schulman guide reacted +11.83%. Subscriber delivery has been bought every time under this CEO.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. These are public CEO statements and sit inside company guidance. What may not be priced is the visibility they imply about Q3 itself. If the market fully trusted the promise, the stock would not sit 13% off its high with the satellite discount on top. Without a sourced Q3 net-add consensus, I cannot say whether the street's number already reflects the 'top end' pace.
findings.independence: Hudson Labs preview (https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/verizon-q3-2026-earnings-preview-vz-guidance-estimates-key, 2026-10-06) carries the same guide and expects significant improvement. Those are the same company statements, so this counts as one source.

findings.finding: SpaceX agreed on 2026-10-08 to buy Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum (about $8bn reported; needs FCC approval) for Starlink Mobile. VZ fell 10.1% on 2026-10-09 to $41.65, of which about $0.71 was the ex-dividend, and sell-side targets were cut (Scotiabank to $50; JPMorgan 49->47 and RBC 46->44 per secondary reports). The Q3 period ended before the deal, so the print cannot show any satellite effect. The 10-26 call is management's first chance to rebut it with October churn and porting data. Schulman already argued on 2026-09-09 that LEO satellite cannot compete where 95-98% of Verizon revenue sits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has had a satellite overhang. AT&T faced the same overhang on 10-21, reassured nobody and fell. That bounds the upside of a rebuttal.
findings.why_not_priced: The derating is priced, at -10% on the day. What is open is whether a lowered bar plus a rebuttal produces relief. The stock has already bounced about 7% off 41.65 and the skew pays upside, which suggests part of the relief is priced too.
findings.independence: https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262208662-market-movers-vz-20261009 (2026-10-09: open -6.39%, PT cuts, Scotiabank named); https://broadbandbreakfast.com/spacex-acquiring-grain-spectrum-to-support-mobile-ambitions/ (deal terms).

findings.finding: Verizon's iPhone 18 Pro launch offer (preorders from 2026-09-12) gives up to $1,200 off a $1,199.99 phone with an eligible trade-in and a new line on a qualifying myPlan, or up to $1,020 off for existing customers who upgrade, paid as 36-month credits. That is effectively a free flagship for a switcher, against the CEO's 'no phones on us' line. It supports late-Q3 gross adds and churn but adds promotional cost to Q4 margins and ARPA. AT&T also flagged promotional discounts on additions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No VZ-specific history found on promotional-cost surprises. Under the prior CEO, promo-heavy quarters with weak adds were sold (the Q3 2025 44k quarter still reacted +2.26% because of the CEO change).
findings.why_not_priced: Launch promos are visible to everyone, and trade-in-based launch offers are industry standard, so this is mostly priced. It would matter only if management quantifies promo cost or guides Q4 ARPA lower. This is a proxy, not a company number.
findings.independence: https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/iphones/verizon-is-practically-giving-away-the-iphone-18-pro-heres-how-to-get-it (date not verified); AT&T 8-K cites promotional discounts on additions.

findings.finding: Insiders made 10 open-market sales and no purchases in the past six months. These include EVP Samantha Hammock (about 73k shares, about $3.5M) and Kyle Malady (9,900 shares, about $476k), and an executive sold at $42.93 on 2026-10-13, after the SpaceX drop. The sizes are small relative to the company and look routine.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None; routine insider sales have not been a visible driver of VZ reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Form 4s are public. The only signal is the absence of any insider buying into a 17.8% drawdown, which is weak.

outside_window.finding: T-Mobile reports Q3 2026 on 2026-10-28 after the close (release about 16:05 ET), two days after the exit. Its account adds and commentary on switching and satellite would be the next read-through.
FCC approval of SpaceX's purchase of Grain's 800 MHz spectrum is pending and undated. Any ruling or comment cycle falls after the window.

baseline_tension: The upside-paid skew (-4.67), the 7-of-7 positive reaction history and the 13% drawdown agree with a mild positive lean. The only hard read-through, AT&T's beat-and-raise being sold two days earlier, cuts against them, so p_up stays close to 50 at 55.
lessons_applied: Core table and LESSONS rule 6 (finding inside company guidance): the CEO top-end/positive-accounts finding cut from +0.8 to +0.4, because it is public guidance the market was told to expect; p_up 56 -> 55.
Rule 6 (bar): no sourced Q3 net-add consensus was found, so findings on that line stay small; EPS and revenue bar sourced to the company guide plus two roughly agreeing estimates.

Rule 7 (positioning): short interest checked before the negatives (3.72 days to cover, about 2% of float, not crowded), so the negative AT&T read-through keeps its size; the positive lean agrees with the upside-paid skew.
Rule 1 (reaction vs fact): print_vs_bar (+0.5) kept separate from the reaction; the AT&T peer reaction-function finding left at -0.8.
